warm_clean.notes: Indoor office, DJI Rec.709. Warmer skin, S-curve contrast, gentle vibrance, delivery sharpen. Add vignette 0.25 on top.

premium_cinematic.notes: Premium look for the office set: rolled-off highlights (white wall stops glaring), richer blacks, cool shadows + warm skin, restrained saturation. Apply 'grade' in the base EDL, then 'finish' in the composite pass (needs depth mask input) BEFORE graphics/text.
premium_cinematic.finish: edge depth blur sigma 10 through assets/luts/depth_mask_1080x1920.png (maskedmerge in gbrp), halation = highlights (curves 0.75→0) blurred sigma 22 screen-blended at 0.18, vignette angle 0.42, grain alls=4 temporal, unsharp 0.35
